siteMetadata.description: Backend Systems and Web Services Expert
siteMetadata.about:
I'm a Software engineer currently working at Nutanix, building mission-critical distributed services for AHV control plane. Previously worked at Walmart, simplifying international trade for sellers on the eCommerce marketplace. Graduated in 2021 with B.E. in Computer Science.
    
    Skilled in:
    ‣ Building scalable distributed systems using Go, Java, gRPC and Kafka.
    ‣ Developing backends for frontends (BFF) using Java (Spring Boot and GraphQL) or Python (Django).
    ‣ Writing Spark jobs for large-scale distributed data processing. 
    ‣ Building reliable and resilient services with redundancy, monitoring, alerting, and disaster recovery processes in place.
    ‣ Building Deep Learning applications and deploying Machine Learning models at scale.
    ‣ Full-stack development using ReactJS with Spring Boot or Django backends, deployed on cloud (AWS) or serverless (Firebase).

    Get in touch at anshulsoodnet@gmail.com if you want to collaborate on a project or have an exciting opportunity for me.

experience.name: Member of Technical Staff - 3, Nutanix
experience.description:
Enhancing performance and building features for VM management.

experience.name: Member of Technical Staff - 2, Nutanix
experience.description:
Authored a library for using gRPC over Envoy L4 proxy, providing load balancing, retries, health checks, and connection pooling. Used by teams across Nutanix.
Contributed to VM Startup Policy feature for configuring VM boot order during HA failover and cluster restart. Modelled dependencies as a graph and applied graph algorithms for cycle detection, conflict resolution, partitioning into subgraphs and determining the final order.
Built a protobuf parsing algorithm to implement PUT semantics while ensuring backward compatibility of APIs.
Tech Stack: Go, Python, Bash, gRPC

experience.name: Software Engineer 3, Walmart Global Tech
experience.description:
‣ Built SWW 2.0 Billing system. SWW - Ship with Walmart, is a multi-tenant SaaS product for providing shipping services with 3rd party carriers.
‣ Involved in end to end product development from requirements gathering, design (LLD), coding, deployment, automated testing and build pipeline integration, setting up monitoring and alerting
‣ Made the complete pipeline Highly Available through multi-region data replication, multi-region Crons and Kafka failover.
‣ Built a Reconciliation System to detect and correct transactional inaccuracies in the system.
‣ Implemented Kafka failover for disaster recovery during a region-level outage. This along with multi-region deployments and multi-region replication ensured high availability of the system. 
Tech Stack: Java, SpringBoot, Kafka, Azure, SQL

experience.name: Software Engineer 2, Walmart Global Tech

projects.name: Twitter Analytics for Demand Forecasting
projects.description: Tweets are fetched from the Twitter API and their sentiment is analyzed to predict the relative demand for products at a chosen locality. This info can help a retailer stock its inventory accordingly.

projects.name: Engagement Intensity Prediction
projects.description: Performs real-time engagement intensity prediction using gaze and pose estimation. The feed is segmented into 10-second video clips, from which facial features are extracted, and then a neural network determines the level of engagement at the given instant.

projects.name: PPE Detection using Computer Vision
projects.description: A solution for detecting if a worker is wearing safety gear while working at the workshop, using CCTV cameras. Uses YOLO for object detection and Deep SORT for person tracking. Has a dashboard built with Tkinter to display real-time feed and show alerts.

projects.name: Position Tracker
projects.description: Developed a localization system for an autonomous bot developed by the college Robotics Club. It polls data from an Optical Displacement Sensor, Gyroscope, Accelerometer, Magnetometer, and fuses them using Kalman filtering. Used Raspberry Pi as the onboard computer.
